decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.
Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [S.BPA, Supporting numbers and deliveries information. Received: 20/01/2026. Operational Management Plan, P401. Received: 18/12/2025. S404, S403, S402, S401, S.SLP, P404, P402, JCW Absorbent Sound Screen information. Received: 03/10/2025].
Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.
Reason: In order to safeguard the appearance of the area.

Condition : 4 - The outbuilding hereby approved shall be used for Use Class E(e) and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class E of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 (as amended), nor in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification.
Reason: The Council is satisfied that the use hereby permitted would not result in detriment to adjoining properties but would wish to control future changes of use within the same Use Class to protect nearby land uses and the character of the area.

Condition : 5 - Patients shall only be permitted on the development hereby permitted between the following hours: 
[09:00 � 18:00] Mondays � Thursdays; 
[09:00 � 17:00 Fridays � Saturdays

Reason: In order to protect neighbours' living conditions.

Condition : 6 - Before the development hereby permitted is first occupied or brought into use, the existing redundant vehicular access shall be permanently closed and kerbs and footway reinstated so that it cannot be used as an access across the pavement.

Reason: In order to enhance the pedestrian environment and to confine vehicular access to the permitted points in order to ensure that the development does not prejudice the free flow of traffic or highway safety along the adjacent highway.

Condition : 7 - Secure covered cycle parking facilities (for not less than 5 bicycles) for the occupants of, and visitors to, the development shall be installed in the location indicated in drawing number S.BPA. The approved facilities shall conform to the current Westtrans West London Cycle Parking Guidance(or such other guidance as shall supersede it) in design and layout and be fully implemented and made available for use before the first occupation of the development or commencement of the approved use as appropriate and thereafter retained for use at all times without obstruction. 

Reason: In order to support sustainable transport objectives.

Condition : 8 - All refuse and recycling bins, delivery cages, trolleys or any other items linked to deliveries and collection in association with the approved development are to be stored within the building(s) at all times and only brought out onto the public highway when deliveries are being made or refuse collected.
Reason: To protect the quality of the local environment and to prevent obstruction and inconvenience to users of the public highway.

Condition : 9 - The outbuilding hereby permitted shall not at any time be used or occupied as a separate unit independent of the main building, and it shall not be provided with or used via any independent external access.
Reason: To ensure that the development remains ancillary to the main building and to safeguard the amenities of neighbouring occupiers.
description: Erection of a detached outbuilding in the rear garden for the use of a chiropractic care and physiotherapy (Use Class E(e) with associated cycle and refuse storage following the demolition of the existing outbuilding.
